body.statement: For a stationary binary-endpoint reanalysis of a logged real-time adaptive trial whose inferior-arm probabilities satisfy the two-sided rare-arm envelope and whose endpoint delays satisfy the polynomial envelope, compute the risk-difference statistic from records observed through \(H_T=T+\Delta_T\). A protocol seeking a uniformly honest guarantee over this informative-delay envelope class may prespecify \(I_{T,\Delta}^{\mathrm W}\) only when \(T^q(1+T+\Delta_T)^{-\beta}\to0\); otherwise the protocol requires \(I_{T,\Delta}^{\mathrm G}\), \(I_{T,\Delta}^{\mathrm{conc}}\), or a prespecified \(\Delta_T\) that makes this ratio vanish. This class-wide necessity does not preclude pointwise validity of ordinary Wald for particular laws, including laws with immediate delays.
body.justification: This translates the uniform theorem into an auditable protocol-level inference choice for delayed cardiovascular endpoints without imposing a necessity claim on each individual delay law or claiming the original simulations satisfy the assumptions.
body.gap: Liberali et al. report resampling intervals and inferior-arm precision costs but no uniform coverage theorem under outcome-dependent ascertainment.
body.consumer: A GUSTO-1 or EUROPA-style protocol can prespecify the tail pad or follow-up period needed for class-wide honesty after verifying the logged propensity and delay-tail envelopes, while permitting an ordinary-Wald pointwise analysis under a separately certified prompt-delay law.
body.proof_tex:
A stationary binary endpoint is a special case of ass:bounded-outcomes, and its risk difference is exactly the causal contrast \(\tau\).  Once the logged inferior-arm probabilities have been verified to satisfy ass:rare-arm-envelope and the endpoint ascertainment times satisfy ass:polynomial-delay-envelope, prop:wald-followup-frontier applies with terminal observation time \(H_T=T+\Delta_T\).  It proves that the unpadded interval \(I_{T,\Delta}^{\mathrm W}\) is uniformly asymptotically honest over the entire informative-delay class exactly when
\[
 T^q(1+T+\Delta_T)^{-\beta}\longrightarrow0.
\]
When this condition is not certified, thm:uniform-gated-inference supplies the bias-aware Gaussian branch and concentration fallback, both computed from the same terminal records, or the protocol may increase its prespecified \(\Delta_T\) until the displayed product vanishes.  The necessity is class-wide: its witness varies the hidden outcome signs while leaving the observed experiment unchanged or asymptotically contiguous.  It therefore does not assert failure at a particular prompt-delay law, which proves the final qualification in the proposition.
